name: resource-degraded-bluetooth
description: Sequential resource transfers (20-60 KB attachments) through a shaped pipe at a degraded-Bluetooth wire: 100 kbps serialization with 30 ms one-way latency. The first scenario where the rtt-proportional machinery - AIMD window growth, eifr-derived deadlines, part-retry schedules - operates above its loopback floors. Time-to-complete is the product; the pipe counts every wire byte, so payload-per-wire-byte is the protocol's measured overhead tax.
conformance: settled == received with byte-identical totals and zero failures; a retry the unshaped run does not pay is a dynamics bug, not wire loss - the pipe delays, it never drops
